verdict.rationale: Batch jobs accept cloud URIs, prefixes, or manifests, explicitly including pre-signed object URLs. Zoom fetches and transcribes those files, with documented job lifecycle and per-file results. The console also lets users enter a URL for a public audio or video file. However, the synchronous transcribe endpoint only accepts a locally uploaded file, and API support for arbitrary public HTTP URLs (as opposed to cloud-storage URIs) is not explicit. Missing for 10: URL input on the synchronous/fast API, explicit API documentation for arbitrary public (non-cloud-storage) URLs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
